emberValueFloor.reason: DR5 reserves ember orange (#FF7A2A family) for the hero; a colour in the hue / saturation band but darker than this reads as black / brown (pupils, soot, leather), not as ember

chapterScope.reason: event colours of later-chapter monsters and pets are web data until each chapter's dark pass (DR11) and stay out of the Chapter 1 build (the W7 sealed gate); their dark pass re-runs the audit with that chapter added to the gating set

o4.rule: no hero colour at sat > 0.5 (value >= 0.35) within 30 deg of moon-tarnish
o4.outcome: the spec hex fails against the hero greens; the stated fallback (toward 150 deg) fails worse; 'shipped' is the nearest hue that clears both the greens and frost (same saturation and value). Provisional: the owner rules (or recolours the two hero greens)
